What is real

Every identifier, wait, tier, destination and state above was read off the running prototype at /mockups/ward-flow/ed/rph-ed on 2026-09-04. Department and ward names come from ward-sites.ts. The 24-hour figure is the department's own access target — not a Mental Health Act deadline.

What is invented

The layout, and two groupings the current screen does not draw: nearest breach as a headline figure, and here, no bed requested as a list of its own. The three sentences under “Needs a decision” are written for this mockup; the facts inside them are the screen’s.

Design

Tokens from src/app/ckb-v2-tokens.css, inlined above verbatim — radii, surfaces, borders, type scale and both themes. No raw colour and no new type step below that block. Rows are separated by hairlines rather than boxed, so a list of four reads as one object.
